claim: Keep Claude Code, Codex and Gemini quota windows visible while you work.
Linux: curl install script or download .deb / .rpm / AppImage; Windows: setup.exe
reason: Installers are coming with v0.1; no release binary or installer has been published yet

claim: Cached and unavailable data remain distinguishable; missing quota never becomes a reassuring zero.
Choose Portrait, Landscape, Square, Circle Dial or Pill in Layout & Position.
Circle and Pill show up to three selected providers; Square pages through additional providers.
In Providers → Provider layout, reorder or hide widget rows without disabling collection.
Choose a featured provider or None; Portrait supports Top / Bottom placement.
Five size presets at 85, 100, 120, 150 and 200 percent (Small, Medium, Large, X-Large, 2X-Large).
Scale text and spacing together from 50% to 300%, with presets or Ctrl +/− and Ctrl+0. Numbers keep proportions.
Every theme includes 12 palettes. New palette, Duplicate, Edit Dark and Light, Export, Import, and contrast warnings.
Choose Calm, Vivid, or Mono color modes. Ten themes change layout and colors. Auto, Light, Dark appearance.
Cached data stays marked, sign-in failures ask for attention, unavailable never becomes zero. Providers without active subscription stay hidden.
Calm uses neutral ink below 50%, amber from 50%, red from 80%. Mono adds hollow warning marks and inverse percentage labels.
Choose 10, 20 or 30 meter marks; XS uses 10.
System theme uses desktop font, light/dark appearance and system accent where supported. It is the default theme.
Windows has an optional taskbar strip with independent provider, window and theme settings.
reason: Windows Explorer taskbar strip is not exercised by the headless browser suite; requires native Windows desktop acceptance.

claim: First launch asks which providers to track; all providers stay disabled until you choose Start. New providers default off.
Requests retrieve usage or balances; collector does not submit prompts or request model completions. Does not scan chat history.
There is no application telemetry or analytics code.
reason: Negative architectural property verified by repository-wide audit of all source files

claim: Daily quote off by default. Contacts en.wikiquote.org and wikidata.org once a day. No account or identifiers sent.
Daily quote batches twelve same-date pages and one Wikidata sitelink; <= 2 HTTP requests; no redirects, cookies or credentials.
Source and CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution accessible from every shape.
In Providers → Limits and pools, choose Automatic, Show or Hide per pool, split pools into separate cards, or Show everything so new limits appear automatically.
Windows and Linux desktop widget with ten themes, five shapes and shared local quota snapshots.
Provider opt-in, palette editing/import/export, layout and placement settings.
Panel integration sources for Plasma, GNOME Shell, Waybar, Polybar and i3blocks.
reason: Panel integration scripts and plasmoid/extension manifests are verified manually in desktop panel environments

claim: Bolder Dot Matrix quota labels, round marks and full-width tracks.
Theme defaults to System when no choice is stored; an existing explicit theme is preserved.
settings.json in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ai-usage (Linux) or %APPDATA%/ai-usage (Windows); window.json separate.
reason: Requires inspecting real file paths created by native app during execution on Linux and Windows

claim: widgetOpacity (UI range 20–100) sets surface opacity; text remains opaque.
Ctrl +/− changes active fine-tune by 5; Ctrl+0 resets fine-tune to 100.
Fit screen effective only for Portrait except Compact Strip; other shapes retain choice but use preset. Width capped at 30% of available width.
fitHeight (true) resizes window to measured content height.
config.json collection interval minimum 30 seconds (default 300); native widget refreshes on startup and every 300s.
reason: Verified by code inspection of interval validation and timer loops; no headless test asserts real 300s interval

claim: key set stores plaintext keys with Unix 0600 or current-user protected Windows DACL.
Hook chaining uses JSON argv array, raw stdin, 5 seconds timeout, max 64 KiB stdout.
Every size, including Ctrl +/- shortcuts, stays inside work area and covers at most 50% (35% for strip).
Save verifies persisted settings by loading them again before displaying saved time; errors remain retryable.
Delete requires in-page confirmation; deleting selected palette restores theme first built-in palette.
Import merges user palettes by ID (matching IDs replaced) and selects first imported palette.
userPalettes format: ID user-[a-z0-9-]{1,64}, name 1-40 unicode chars, 11 tokens per dark/light mode.
Invalid imports reject entire operation and display error. Invalid palettes on disk discarded with warning.
limitVisibility stores per-pool booleans (<provider>/<pool>), ignoring non-boolean values; explicit choices override automatic and Show extra windows.
separatePools places each visible non-main pool into its own card (<provider>~<pool>) after its base provider while preserving history totals.
All themes have 20 marks per quota window by default. Settings selects 10, 20 or 30. XS uses 10.
Five presets multiply all logical dimensions uniformly: Small 85%, Medium 100%, Large 120%, X-Large 150%, 2X-Large 200%.
Effective scale bounded to 10–300% at IPC boundary; non-finite falls back to 100%.
At Medium, with n = visible provider count, Portrait ceiling width = 340, height = 116 + 210 * n.
Compact Strip at Medium requests width = 30 + 310 * n, height = 326: 300px cards, 10px gaps.
Titles read AI USAGE with one literal word space, nonnegative letter spacing, same family as body, no stretch.
Thresholds: <50% normal, 50% to <80% warning (hollow marks), >=80% danger (inverse labels).
Match physical size across monitors is off by default; when enabled, divides Scale by native scale factor.
Text must not use transform scale, font-stretch or vw/cqw units for font size.
Save or Discard closes Settings after resolving pending changes. Cancel keeps Settings open. A reused window reloads its saved baseline with the existing listeners.
Gear and context menu open decorated settings window (900 x 680, min 640 x 480).
Placement defaults to locked; Place widget temporarily unlocks header; 12px edges/center and 8px grid snapping.
Landscape is 680 x 340 and Square is 340 x 340 at Medium, independent of provider count.
Medium circle is 340 x 340 px; Medium pill is 480 x 120 px.
Native input regions match silhouette: Win32 physical-pixel ellipse/capsule, GTK logical-pixel cairo scanlines.
reason: Input-region hit testing requires a native Windows or GTK compositor; no local native window is launched by this acceptance run.

claim: Quote text shrinks to 11px (9px circle), then truncates at word boundary with explicit ellipsis.
Portrait Fit width cannot exceed 30% of available work area.
KDE Plasma 6 Wayland: GTK3 layer-shell corners; ordinary window fallback without library.
reason: Requires native KDE Plasma 6 Wayland with layer-shell; the CI/headless harness does not provide that compositor.

claim: libgtk-layer-shell.so.0 loaded dynamically; absence does not prevent startup.
reason: Dynamic library absence/startup fallback requires launching the native binary on Linux with and without libgtk-layer-shell.

claim: Layer-shell default: bottom layer, top-right, 12px margin, Auto monitor.
Panel readers are passive: `python3 -m quotacore bar --format waybar` reads snapshot without network/credentials.
quotacore pace collects fresh snapshot and prints pacing profile (SAVE, NORMAL, SPARE, LAST_CALL, UNKNOWN).
Optional pacing ceilings in pace.json, default 90%.
Recent stale snapshots remain usable up to max_age_minutes; older or undated stale data reported as UNKNOWN.
Expired windows are treated as reset, with zero usage for the new period.
Profile history stored in pace-state.json to preserve SPARE hysteresis.
History private (0600), pruned to 30 days and 1 MiB. quotacore pace --purge removes history and state.
Filesystem watcher forwards snapshot changes; fallback read runs every 300 seconds.
Frontend stops polling while page is hidden, and recovers on visibility.
Rendering requests coalesced into one animation frame; hidden pages defer drawing.
Infinite CSS animations disabled when reactorMotion is false or prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Theme CSS, renderer and palette dynamically imported.
Release profile uses size profile z, LTO, one codegen unit, abort-on-panic and symbol stripping.
reason: Static Rust compiler configuration in app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml

claim: Idle CPU <0.1% target passed; <150 MB memory target did NOT pass (measured 154-157 MiB).
reason: Documented in performance.md that the <150 MB memory target was not delivered by the release binary

claim: Writer collects enabled providers into shared snapshot. Missing values are unknown, never assumed zero.
Claude: Reads credentials, GET api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage. No token renewal. Falls back to observations, then cache.
Codex: Starts codex app-server, JSON-RPC account/rateLimits/read, stops process. No direct auth.json read.
reason: Requires installed Codex CLI with working app-server subcommand

claim: Gemini: Reads gemini-kota.json; explicit refresh runs `agy -p /usage --output-format json`; cache older than 7 days rejected.
reason: Requires Antigravity agy command installed and signed in

claim: Copilot: Runs `gh auth token`, GET api.github.com/copilot_internal/user.
reason: Requires GitHub CLI token with internal Copilot endpoint permissions

claim: Failure states: STALE, AUTH_REQUIRED, RATE_LIMITED, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, SCHEMA_CHANGED, DISABLED, NOT_INSTALLED, NO_SUBSCRIPTION (hidden).
CI checks Ubuntu and Windows frontend builds and Rust compilation, plus Python tests on Ubuntu.
Build matrix targets Windows x86_64 (.exe and .msi) and Linux x86_64 (AppImage, deb, rpm).
reason: Installer compilation is configured in CI build workflows and triggered on tag push

claim: All external actions pinned to full commit SHAs; Rust pinned to 1.99.1; release builds use --locked.
reason: Verified by static review of .github/workflows/*.yml

claim: No application telemetry, analytics, developer upload, background update check, or remote webview content.
reason: Negative property verified by source code inspection

claim: New installation starts with every provider disabled. Choose what to track lists access disclosures and unchecked choices. Start persists choices.
Detection checks directory/file existence; never opens credential contents, runs provider CLIs, or sends requests.
Direct HTTP calls are bodyless GETs to fixed HTTPS URLs (anthropic, copilot, openrouter, deepseek).
Direct requests reject HTTP redirects, have 15-second timeout and 1 MiB response limit.
key set reads stdin and saves unencrypted plaintext keys in secrets.json with Unix 0600 or current-user Windows DACL.
Atomic temporary files receive restriction before secret contents are written; failure aborts save.
Pace history retains at most 1 MiB and records from last 30 days, pruning on each run. pace --purge removes history without collection.
Native collector runner has 120s deadline, 1 MiB stdout limit, process tree isolated in process group or Job Object with kill-on-close.
Hook input limited to 1 MiB; chain-cmd uses argv; chain timeout 5s, stdout 64 KiB.
Start at login is an explicit toggle: HKCU Run value (Windows) or per-user autostart desktop entry (Linux).
reason: Autostart registration requires native OS integration; the acceptance suite does not modify the host login configuration.

claim: Windows taskbar strip creates no GUI thread/window/hook while off; SetWinEventHook listens only for Explorer location changes; no keylogging or injection.
reason: Requires Windows Explorer runtime inspection; this suite does not validate native taskbar hooks.

claim: Production frontend bundled locally; CSP restricts resources and IPC.
reason: Verified by static inspection of index.html and tauri.conf.json security CSP fields

claim: Snapshot text is escaped; state classes use a fixed allowlist.
